required_approval: User training instruction prohibits silent setting changes; this changes a GPU hardware operating limit.
driver_permission_note: May require administrator/driver permission; do not start unless successful readback confirms the approved limit.
conditions: Preserve the same dataset/model revision, seed, optimizer state, two-epoch schedule and all checkpoints.
Record the hardware power limit change in the run evidence; do not imply the original hardware operating conditions continued unchanged.
Monitor temperature and progress through the next complete checkpoint; the setting does not establish that the hardware fault is fixed.
If an approved cap resets after reboot, verify/reapply the approved cap before another GPU launch; never fall back silently to 140W.
Use matching hardware conditions for later v8/v6 development latency measurements.
